messages:
maria: Quick design sync: we need a simpler flow for automatic fallback thresholds. two proposals: (A) expose separate knobs for latency / error-rate / queue-length, or (B) show a single "health" slider + an advanced panel for experts. which way for Console?
kevin: leaning B. health slider for 90% of users, advanced rules tucked behind 'customize' so power users can add multiple clauses. presets = good.
olivia: agree on presets. UX note 12: degrade-mode naming needs to be customer-friendly. current internal names are too nerdy. propose labels: "Graceful downgrade", "Minimal fallback", "Hard failover" with one-liners.
sam: telemetry requirements: every fallback event must capture: original_model, fallback_model, trigger_metric, trigger_value, request_id, latency_ms, timestamp. retention defaults: 90d but enterprise can bump. also include sampling controls to avoid massive ingestion.
aaron: API-side: policy schema should be explicit about metric units and comparator semantics. e.g. {"metric":"p95_latency_ms","op":">=","value":"120"}. no fuzzy names. also add optional human_label.
kevin: UI panels: small traffic simulator on the policy page. instant client-side estimates (fast) and a server-side "run full sim" that uses real histograms and returns accurate projections: fallback_rate, estimated_cost_delta, top triggers. sim results get stored as run entries for audit.
maria: audit/logging: every policy change needs changelog entry + link to sim run that validated it. show undo for 7 days. also surface a mini diff on hover.
olivia: message to docs folks: i'll write plain-language tooltips for modes + examples (when customers should pick each).
sam: sim API sketch:
POST /v1/policies/{id}/simulate
payload: {"traffic_profile":"histogram || qps/avg_len","period_hours":24}
response: {"proj_fallback_count":...,"proj_cost_delta":...,"breakdown_by_reason":[...]}
needs to include confidence intervals.
aaron: server design note: full sim should support synthetic replay as well as histo-driven probabilistic sim. do we want to store simulation seeds for reproducibility? i'd vote yes.
sim-bot: queued sim job sim-4445 for policy p-77. notif on complete. :rocket:
kevin: small UX detail: when rollout <100% we should show per-percent expected fallback delta in a tiny sparkline; this helps during canaries.
maria: security & privacy: sim results containing sampled traces must redact PII and follow org-level verbose_audit flag. default false.
sam: telemetry UI proposal:
- header: policy name + active degrade mode + rollout %
- mid: triggers timeline + stacked area of fallback counts by reason
- bottom: sample traces + export CSV + "open trace" action
I can wire a proto by Friday.
olivia: also need a warning modal when thresholds are lower than recommended (shows estimated user impact).
aaron: open debate 10: should comparator ops be inclusive (>=) or strict (>) by default? we should standardize. prefer >= to avoid off-by-one surprises.
maria: decision: use explicit comparators in schema, recommend >= in UI but show the operator so it's clear. action items: kevin -> update API spec (metric schema + simulate endpoint + sim-result storage); sam -> telemetry proto + retention UI; olivia -> copy for modes + warning modal; aaron -> sim server design + reproducible seeds; maria -> console mock + presets. sync Thu 9am.
maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
